SITE LINK FINDER
================

Crawls a whole website and answers two questions:
  1. Where on the site does a given link sit?
  2. Which links are broken, and why?

Nothing needs to be installed. Windows 10/11 64-bit is enough.


HOW TO START
------------
1. Double-click SiteLinkFinder.exe
2. A black console window opens and your browser opens the interface.
   If Windows says "Windows protected your PC": More info -> Run anyway.
   (That warning only means the file is not code-signed.)
3. The first launch takes a few seconds while the app unpacks itself.
4. To quit: close the black console window.


HOW TO USE
----------
Pick one of three modes at the top:

  Find a link    Enter the domain (e.g. example.com) and the link you are looking
                 for. A fragment like /old-page works, so does a full URL.
                 The result shows every page where that link appears.

  Broken links   Enter the domain only. The result lists every dead link, the
                 reason it is dead, and the page it sits on.
                 Advanced settings here offer "Also find pages with no internal
                 links" - pages that open fine but that nothing on the site
                 links to. Needs the site to have a sitemap.xml.

  Site map       Enter the domain only. Returns the list of all pages found.

Then press Start. Progress and a live log appear below; Stop interrupts the scan
and keeps whatever has been collected so far.


READING THE RESULTS
-------------------
"Where exactly" column:
  On the page  - a normal link or button, you can see it by looking at the page
  Technical    - the link only exists in the code (SEO tags, scripts). Looking for
                 it on the page itself is pointless; open the page source instead.

Under each found link you also see whether it still works, or the error it returns.

Excel: press "Download Excel". The file is created only when you press that button
and is also kept in the "results" folder next to the .exe.


IF SOMETHING GOES WRONG
-----------------------
Very few pages found      The site has no sitemap, or an incomplete one. Open
                          "Advanced settings" and make sure "Follow links" is on;
                          try "Include subdomains" too.

Many 403 or 429 errors    The site is throttling robots. In "Advanced settings"
                          set Threads to 3 and Pause to 0.5 sec, then retry.
                          403 links are often fine - spot-check a couple by hand.

Scan takes too long       Set "Crawl depth" to 1 or 2 in Advanced settings.
